newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Panamerican Beverages raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Panamerican Beverages raised.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said it upgraded Panamerican Beverages Inc to buy from hold.
-- raised earnings estimate to $2.73 per share from $2.38 for 1997, citing expected operating margin improvement in all territories.
-- said change in expectations for 1997 is related to cost factors rather than market conditions.
-- said company's mineral water products represent its fastest growing segment and typically have higher margins than soft drinks.
-- ADRs closed up 1/4 to 46-1/2 on Monday.
